externalCpuBoundsMethod: Lower: sum of observed per-PID/startTicks CPU counter deltas minus 20 ms each (two 100 Hz ticks), floor zero. Upper: whole-cgroup usage delta minus conservative observed owned and observer lower bounds. Upper includes unseen short-lived work and boundary gaps; it is intentionally loose, not an attribution. Raw observed CPU and classified active >500 ms processes are also retained. Only numeric facts, not unrelated argv, are used.
limitations: Natural cache/network history, not cache-reset A/B; A1 resolution combined marker 120 versus 1 for later resolving installs
Two samples only; no stable percentiles
No named heavy competitors and no observed unclassified process exceeded 500 ms per command, but sub-500 ms processes and interval gaps remain
Fixed lock proves only this exact current candidate, not future new candidate migration
B1 lock generation cost fully retained; one Gate has one install and cannot assume amortization
Initial separate harness run banned unrelated /tmp/node_modules and failed before any install; explicitly authorized correction preserved original evidence
No full Gate or production source change
costBoundary: phaseWallMs is child spawn-to-wait4 completion, about 10 ms polling precision. setupPlusAcceptanceMs adds first tar/graph audit but excludes 2-second per-child observer preflights, snapshots, and final post-acceptance identity recheck. Real B1-to-C2 timeline is separately recorded, includes 28 seconds of observer preflight; none is described as a full Gate metric.

conditions.baseline: Fresh ancestry-external consumer; exact original bun install --no-save --ignore-scripts <current tarball>
conditions.resolve-then-frozen: Fresh consumer declares only exact current tarball. bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts followed by bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts. Both costs included.
conditions.frozen-seed: Fresh consumer receives only B1 package.json and Bun-authored bun.lock, never node_modules; frozen real install. B1 resolution cost separately charged; not a new persistent cache or a claim about future candidates.

plan.failurePolicy: Stop the complete sequence after any actual install/acceptance failure or environmental preflight block; no retries or replacements.
plan.cache: Existing Bun global install cache at natural state, no flush/warmup/new custom cache; Bun itself may read/write it. Fresh consumer for every attempt.
plan.network: Registry reads/downloads may occur on unresolved or missing packages; no publish or credentials output. Resolution output markers are not network traces.
correctness: exact tarball sha before every install
all installed candidate bytes equal tar member bytes
candidate-only manifest except baseline private manifest
all installed dependency license audit and Ajv/jscpd/markdownlint owner probes
all direct dependency constraints from installed candidate checked
lock bytes unchanged after frozen installs
limits: Two observations per condition support ranges only, not stable quantiles
Fixed current artifact does not prove migration to a future candidate version
Lock generation cost is not removed from total cost
Bun latest online documentation may differ from local 1.3.14; local execution is authoritative
Full Gate not run and unchanged budgets not proven
plan.correction: Initial harness failed before any install because it incorrectly banned unrelated /tmp/node_modules. Original attempt preserved; parent explicitly authorized one corrected experiment. Actual package and dependency containment remains checked.
